This small tuber plot is my own land, and because it is small and intercropped, I will manage it mostly with family effort and with what I can afford. I will use some chemical fertilizer if I can get it, but not too much, and I will also add manure because soils here are tired. I will plant improved seed if I can find it from an agro-dealer, but I do not expect to irrigate since I depend on the rains, and I will only use a little chemical for weeds or pests if needed.
